idea-plugin.name: Worktree Lifecycle MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Let your MCP client manage independent IntelliJ Platform projects by directory, without attaching them to another project or opening duplicate windows.

  • Inspect open projects and their window state.
  • Open or reuse a project; close an exact project with normal IDE safeguards.
  • Optionally merge all eligible macOS project windows into native tabs.
  • Find IDE actions by name or ID, inspect availability, and run an exact action.
  • Discover and switch Git worktrees; preview and confirm safe worktree creation and removal through MCP.
  • Open a selected Git worktree and merge all windows from the IDE's native Worktrees panel.
  • Use the permanent Worktree Lifecycle Git tab for inline sync/review status and selectable worktree cleanup with verified merge evidence, closed-unmerged opt-in and separately confirmed local branch/change deletion.

MCP tools require the bundled MCP Server and a connected MCP client. The Worktree Lifecycle tab and native Worktrees actions also work directly inside the IDE; window merging is available on macOS.

Supports IntelliJ Platform builds 263.7307.202 through 263.*. Actions use project/window context or an explicitly requested, already-open text editor in that project. macOS fullscreen and Spaces merging is best-effort.

Documentation · Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Unreleased — Permanent Worktree Lifecycle Git tab with repository selection, inline status and refresh, native project/review operations, and shared IDE/MCP cleanup previews. Select safe or all eligible worktrees; local branch and change deletion require separate explicit approval. The native Working Trees tab is preserved.

1.0.3 — Requires IntelliJ Platform 263.7307.202 or later within 263.*.

1.0.2 — Support IntelliJ Platform 263 (2026.3), retaining compatibility with supported 262 builds.

1.0.1 — Automated signed release publishing. Plugin functionality is unchanged from 1.0.0.

1.0.0 — First stable release of project lifecycle and context-aware IDE action tools.

0.5.1 — Allow IntelliJ Platform 262 patch updates while retaining the minimum supported build. Use platform-supported explicit action contexts for injected-language handling.

0.5.0 — Shared action availability reasons for search and dispatch, including modal preflight.

0.4.0 — Optional explicit file/editor context for action search and dispatch without selecting tabs.

0.3.0 — New plugin logo and expanded plugin description.

0.2.0 — Search IDE actions by name or ID with project-scoped availability.

0.1.0 — Exact-directory project open, reuse, close, window merge, and action execution.
